raw_ingredients_text: 2 cups Idli Rice (parboiled), 1/2 cup whole white Urad Dal, 1 tsp Fenugreek seeds (methi), 1 tsp rock salt, water for grinding
cooking_instructions: Soak rice and urad dal with fenugreek separately for 4 hours. Grind urad dal to fluffy batter and rice to coarse batter. Mix with salt and ferment overnight (8-10 hours). Pour into greased idli plates and steam for 10-12 minutes.

raw_ingredients_text: 3 cups Idli Rice, 1 cup whole Urad Dal, 2 tbsp Chana Dal, 1 tsp Methi seeds, 2 tbsp sesame oil, salt to taste
cooking_instructions: Grind soaked grains into smooth pouring batter. Ferment for 12 hours. Heat cast-iron tawa, spread ladleful of batter in spiral motion. Drizzle sesame oil around edges and cook until golden brown and crisp.

raw_ingredients_text: 1 cup Raw Rice, 1/2 cup Yellow Moong Dal, 3 tbsp Pure Cow Ghee, 1 tsp whole Black Peppercorns, 1 tsp Cumin Seeds (Jeera), 1 tbsp minced Ginger, 1 sprig Curry leaves, 10 whole Cashew nuts, 1/4 tsp Asafoetida (Hing), salt to taste
cooking_instructions: Dry roast moong dal until fragrant. Pressure cook rice and dal with 4.5 cups water and salt until mushy. In small pan, heat ghee, roast cashews, add pepper, cumin, ginger, curry leaves, and hing. Pour tempering over cooked pongal and mix gently.

raw_ingredients_text: 500g Chicken cut with bone, 500g Seeraga Samba Rice, 3 large sliced Onions, 2 ripe Tomatoes, 1/2 cup Thick Curd, 2 tbsp Ginger-Garlic paste, 3 tbsp Ghee, 2 tbsp Cooking Oil, 4 Green chillies, 1 cup Mint and Coriander leaves, Whole Spices (Cinnamon, Cloves, Cardamom, Bay leaf, Star Anise), Red chilli powder, Turmeric, Salt
cooking_instructions: Marinate chicken in curd, ginger-garlic and spices for 30 minutes. Sauté whole spices, sliced onions until deep caramelized brown. raw_ingredients_text: 1 cup Toor Dal (arhar), 1 Drumstick cut into pieces, 10 Shallots (sambar vengayam), 1 Tomato, 1 small lime size Tamarind (extracted in 1.5 cups water), 2 tbsp Homemade Sambar Powder, 1/2 tsp Turmeric, 1 tsp Mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp Fenugreek seeds, 2 dry Red chillies, 1 sprig Curry leaves, 2 tsp Sesame oil, pinch of Hing
cooking_instructions: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric until smooth. Cook shallots and drumstick in tamarind water with sambar powder and salt until tender. raw_ingredients_text: 350g Boneless Chicken cubes, 2 tbsp Kashmiri red chilli powder, 1 tbsp Ginger-garlic paste, 2 tbsp Corn flour, 1 tbsp Rice flour, 1 Egg white, 1 tbsp Lemon juice, 2 tbsp Curd, 1 sprig Curry leaves, 2 slit Green chillies, Refined oil for deep frying
cooking_instructions: Marinate chicken pieces with chilli powder, ginger-garlic, curd, lemon juice, flours and egg white for 45 minutes. Deep fry in hot oil until crisp and deep red. In another pan, toss fried chicken with fresh curry leaves and slit green chillies.

cooking_instructions: Soak urad dal for 2 hours. Grind in wet grinder with sprinkles of ice water into thick aerated fluffy batter. Mix in pepper, cumin, ginger, chillies, curry leaves and salt. Shape into rounds with hole in center on wet plastic sheet and deep fry until crispy golden.
